intro.title: Place the order
intro.text: Three short steps: details, delivery or pickup, then review and payment. This guide runs on demand with the '?' button.

stepper.title: Where you are
stepper.text: The bar shows the current step. The browser Back button takes you to the previous step.

step.title: The current step
step.text: Fill in the fields then tap 'Continue'. On the last step, review everything, accept the terms and pay. 'Edit' lets you fix your details or delivery.

total.title: Total to pay
total.text: Subtotal, delivery fee by zone, and total. If prices are shown in another currency, you are charged in FCFA.

intro.title: Your orders
intro.text: All your orders, newest first: reference, date, status and total.

list.title: The list
list.text: One card per order: items, delivery progress once paid, and action buttons (resume payment, invoice, WhatsApp question).

details.title: Details and tracking
details.text: Opens the order: delivery steps, address, carrier and tracking number.

intro.title: Order tracking
intro.text: Everything about this order, top to bottom: status, delivery, items and total.

hero.title: Status
hero.text: The reference, date and status. If payment did not go through, a button lets you resume it.

timeline.title: Progress
timeline.text: Delivery steps: received, preparing, shipped, delivered. It appears once the order is paid.

items.title: Your items
items.text: The items and prices in detail.

actions.title: Invoice and help
actions.text: Download the invoice of a paid order, or ask a question on WhatsApp: the message is pre-filled with the order details.

intro.title: Your account
intro.text: Manage your details, delivery addresses and password.

tabs.title: Three tabs
tabs.text: Profile, Addresses and Security. The chosen tab is kept in the page address.

content.title: The tab content
content.text: In Addresses, adding one takes 3 steps, and the default address pre-fills your orders.

links.title: Shortcuts
links.text: Direct access to your orders (and your courses if you are a student).

intro.title: Your meetings
intro.text: Live sessions in progress, scheduled sessions and invitations received.

live.title: Live now
live.text: Sessions open right now. Tap 'Join' to enter.

upcoming.title: Upcoming
upcoming.text: Sessions scheduled by the team, with date and time. A reminder is sent before they start.

invites.title: Invitations received
invites.text: Invitations to a session. Unread ones have a coloured border and a dot.

intro.title: Notifications
intro.text: Live reminders, scheduled sessions and invitations.

readall.title: Mark all as read
readall.text: Clears the red badge in the menu at once. It only shows when there are unread messages.

list.title: Your messages
list.text: Tap a notification's button to join: it is then marked as read.

range.title: Choose the period
range.text: 7, 30, 90 days, 12 months or custom dates. Every figure is compared with the previous period.

intro.title: Shop overview
intro.text: A visual summary of the shop over the chosen period.

actions.title: Refresh and export
actions.text: Refresh the figures, or download the overview as CSV or PDF.

todo.title: To process
todo.text: Items that need action: stock conflicts, sold-out products, pending orders. Each number leads to the right page.

kpi.title: Indicators
kpi.text: Orders, revenue collected, payment rate and average basket, with the change from the previous period.

section.title: Charts
section.text: Rings by theme: statuses, delivery, sales, stock, invoices. Hover a slice for details.

intro.title: Orders
intro.text: The order processing hub. Filters and search are kept in the page address.

chips.title: Quick filters
chips.text: To process, Today, Stock conflicts, or by status. The number is the order count.

search.title: Search
search.text: By order number, name, email or phone.

export.title: CSV export
export.text: Downloads the orders matching the current filters.

list.title: The list
list.text: One row per order (cards on mobile): customer, total, status and actions.

select.title: Multi-select
select.text: Tick several orders to move them to the next step at once.

details.title: Details
details.text: Shows phone, address and items, lets you pick the delivery step and print the delivery note.

next.title: Next step
next.text: Moves delivery forward one step (preparing, shipped, delivered). The customer sees progress on their tracking page.

markpaid.title: Mark as paid
markpaid.text: For a payment confirmed offline. Check the payment first: the action is logged under your name and the customer gets their invoice by email.

intro.title: Products
intro.text: The shop catalog, published or draft.

add.title: New product
add.text: Opens the form: FR/EN names and descriptions, price, main photo. Extra images are added after saving.

list.title: The list
list.text: Each product with its price, stock and Published or Draft status.

edit.title: Actions
edit.text: Edit, Publish or Hide, Delete. Stock is changed from the Stock page.

form.title: Product form
form.text: Leave English empty to show the French version. Tick 'Published' to make the product visible in the shop.

intro.title: Stock management
intro.text: Track levels, fix gaps and keep the history of every movement.

kpi.title: Key figures
kpi.text: Products, units, stock value, low stock, sold out, and units reserved by pending orders.

tabs.title: Two views
tabs.text: Inventory (current state) and Movement log (history, filterable by reason, date and product).

filters.title: Filters
filters.text: Low stock, Sold out, With reservations, Unpublished.

actions.title: Per-product actions
actions.text: Adjust: restock, damage, inventory or correction. History: the product's movements. Hide or Publish: its visibility on the site.

kpi.title: Summary
kpi.text: Number of invoices, issued, cancelled and amount issued.

zip.title: Downloads
zip.text: Download the selection, or the whole filtered result as a ZIP within the stated limit.

table.title: The list
table.text: Tick invoices to group them, open the linked order or download a PDF.

add.title: Add a student
add.text: Creates or finds an account by email, grants access to the courses and can enroll them in a course.

enroll.title: Enroll
enroll.text: Enrolls an existing student in a course.

kpi.title: Indicators
kpi.text: Students, enrollments, completion rate and average progress, with the change over the period.

add.title: Add a course
add.text: Title, description, price, video ID (Bunny Stream) and LiveKit room for live sessions.

table.title: Course list
table.text: Edit, Publish or Hide, Delete. An unpublished course stays hidden.

form.title: Course form
form.text: The video ID enables playback, the live room enables live sessions. Tick 'Published' to open it.

intro.title: Scheduled sessions
intro.text: Announce a live session in advance so students get notified.

form.title: New session
form.text: Choose the course, date and time, then an optional title and message.

when.title: Date and time
when.text: It must be in the future.

notify.title: Notify
notify.text: If ticked, enrolled students and invitees are notified right away, and a reminder is also sent 15 minutes before.

list.title: Upcoming
list.text: The scheduled sessions. Delete one if it is cancelled.

intro.title: Enrollments
intro.text: Who follows which course, with their progress and certificate.

status.title: Status
status.text: Filter In progress or Completed enrollments.

table.title: The table
table.text: Remove (the student loses access to the course and live), download or reissue the certificate once the course is completed.

intro.title: Users
intro.text: The platform's accounts, reserved for super admins.

table.title: Manage access
table.text: Make admin, make student (course access), block or unblock. You cannot change your own account or block an admin.

intro.title: Activity log
intro.text: Every sensitive action, with its author.

search.title: Filter
search.text: Type part of the action, for example order or user.

table.title: The log
table.text: Date, author, action, subject and details.
